dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Significant non-linear narrowing of the visible body mass beginning posterior to the mid-section and tapering toward a rounded posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Pronounced bilateral inward curvature at the anterior-cranial junction (neck); slight asymmetrical bulging on the right lateral margin compared to the left.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white to high-intensity light grey median pixel value across the entire visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low; minimal dark-pixel clusters localized primarily around the cranial-torso junction and the blowhole perimeter.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the high-intensity dorsal center and the lower-intensity lateral margins where the skin meets the water.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single dark, high-contrast elliptical aperture on the anterior dorsal midline.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Multiple faint horizontal linear indentations visible across the mid-dorsal width, creating subtle shadow-casting textures.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of repetitive horizontal linear striations or creases across the mid-to-posterior dorsal plane.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive cranial-torso separation via a visible neck-like constriction, isolating the rounded anterior-most segment.
